resources.name: Asian Americans For Equality
resources.mission: Through community development, Asian Americans for Equality (AAFE) advances racial, social and economic justice for all, regardless of background, guided by our experiences as Asian Americans and our commitment to civil rights.

resources.name: CAIPA Foundation, Inc.
resources.mission: CAIPA Foundation, Inc. promotes community wellness by enriching the health of Asian Americans-especially Chinese Americans-through culturally sensitive programs that improve access to medical services. It advances health equity via education, advocacy, and grantmaking to support community service, health awareness, and research initiatives. Its efforts ensure that underserved individuals receive high-quality, accessible care tailored to linguistic and cultural needs.
resources.languages: English, Chinese, and Chinese regional dialects

resources.name: CAIPA Foundation, Inc.
resources.mission: CAIPA Foundation is dedicated to improving the overall health and well-being of Asian Americans, especially the Chinese American community, through culturally sensitive programs. We advance health equity, expand access to care, and support community growth through education, advocacy, and philanthropy. Our core initiatives include the Food Pantry, Public Health Education, and the Family Service Center, ensuring that underserved individuals receive comprehensive, linguistically and culturally appropriate support.
resources.languages: English, Chinese, and Chinese regional dialects

resources.name: Flushing Council on Culture and the Arts DBA Flushing Town Hall
resources.mission: The mission of Flushing Council on Culture and the Arts DBA Flushing Town Hall is to present multi-disciplinary global arts that engage and educate the global communities of Queens, New York and New York City, New York, in order to foster mutual appreciation. As advocates of arts equity since 1979, we support local, immigrant, national, and international artists, developing partnerships and collaborations that enhance our efforts. As a member of New York City's Cultural Institutions Group (CIG), we serve as stewards of Flushing Town Hall, restoring, managing and programming the historic 1862 landmark on behalf of the City of New York. As an arts council, we offer professional development workshops, town halls, artist meetups & space grants. We allocate $450,000 to Queens based artists & arts organizations through two regrants: the Arts Grants for Queens program funded by New York State Council on the Arts (NYSCA) funds arts & culture projects & the GO Queens Grant funded by Howard Gilman Foundation funds general operating support for performing arts. We also run the NYSCA-appointed Queens Cultural Mapping Initiative.
resources.social: Facebook: @Flushing Town Hall; Instagram: @flushing_town_hall; LinkedIn: @Flushing Town Hall; Twitter/X: @FlushingTwnHall
resources.languages: English, Mandarin, Hindi, Korean, and Spanish
resources.fees: Global arts programs such as concerts or cultural festivals are ticketed at low-ticket prices, sometimes free. Arts services such as regrant support and professional development are free.

resources.name: Green Earth Urban Gardens Inc
resources.mission: Green Earth Urban Gardens, Inc.'s purpose is to promote social and environmental solutions through urban agriculture and therapeutic gardening throughout the borough of Queens, NY.

resources.name: Joanna Sophia Foundation
resources.mission: Our Mission is to advance public awareness of epilepsy and the risk of Sudden Unexpected Death in Epilepsy (SUDEP), to donate to research in finding a cure for epilepsy and to help families with financial needs living with children with epilepsy.

resources.name: Queens Botanical Garden
resources.mission: Queens Botanical Garden (QBG) is an urban oasis where people, plants, and cultures are celebrated through inspiring gardens, innovative educational programs, and real-world applications of environmental stewardship.

resources.name: Queens Historical Society
resources.mission: Our mission is to preserve and chronicle the history of the borough of Queens. The Queens Historical Society is located at the 250 year old Kingsland Homestead in Flushing's Weeping Beech Park!

resources.name: Queens School of Jazz & Contemporary Music
resources.mission: Our mission is to gather, heal, and grow the community through affordable access to jazz mentoring and performance workshops.

resources.languages: Hindi, Bengali, Urdu, Punjabi, Gujarati, Kannada, Marathi, Malayalam, Nepali, Tamil, Telugu, Cantonese, Mandarin, Hakka, Tibetan, Malay, French and Haitian Creole, Spanish, Tagalog and English.

resources.name: St. Fidelis RC Church Street Outreach
resources.mission: The St. Fidelis Roman Catholic Church Street Outreach is a parish based volunteer program wherein once each month our team goes out on the street in the parish neighborhood and offers free food, clothing, hygienic supplies, even children's toys and school supplies and referrals of various sorts to anyone who asks. In significant distinction to the "food pantry" model, in addition to giving out free food and clothing, we make an affirmative effort to get to know the people who come to us, and to identify the homeless and housing insecure amongst them. We then work on a highly individualized basis to meet their needs including and especially to get them off the street and into sustainable living situations - not to just send them to shelters
resources.languages: English, Spanish. But we serve people speaking many other languages as well.

resources.name: The Rick Miller Foundation
resources.mission: The Rick Miller Foundation empowers underserved youth and families through programs that address hunger, mentorship, and personal growth. Our core initiatives-the Community Pantry, the Young King Initiative & Crown Her mentorship programs, and the Magical Music Programprovide essential resources, educational opportunities, and creative outlets, supported by partnerships with Whole Foods and other community allies, to build resilience, leadership, and self-worth. Our mission is to create lasting impact by ensuring every individual has the tools and support needed to thrive. We are committed to bringing high-quality, organic food and transformative opportunities into communities that deserve to live healthy, empowered, and dignified lives.

resources.name: The Rick Miller Foundation
resources.mission: The Magical Music Program empowers youth facing hardship by providing a safe space for creative expression, skill-building, and mentorship through music. We connect participants with industry professionals, studio access, and performance opportunities to nurture both talent and confidence. Our mission is to offer creative expression, mentorship, studio access, and performance opportunities through music. Beyond music, MMP fosters discipline, teamwork, and self-worth-skills that extend far beyond the studio and into every aspect of their lives.
